extracted.name: Quinoa chilli with avocado & coriander
extracted.description: Pack in the nutrients with this meat-free chilli. It delivers five of your 5-a-day and is low in fat
ingredient_lines: 2 tsp vegetable bouillon powder (check the label if you’re vegan)
400g can black beans drained and rinsed
2 tbsp bio yogurt or coconut yogurt (optional)
1 small avocado stoned, peeled and sliced
instruction_lines: Heat the oil in a non-stick frying pan and fry the onion and garlic for 8 mins. Add the pepper and spices to taste and fry for 1 min more.
Tip in the tomatoes and a can of water, stir in the oregano, bouillon and quinoa, bring to the boil, then cover and simmer for 20 mins.
Stir in the black beans and cook, uncovered, for 5 mins more. Add most of the coriander, then serve topped with the yogurt (if using), the remaining coriander and the avocado slices.
